meta.decision_rationale: The competitive map identifies how the library differentiates from digital platforms and corporate community spaces, and where the strategic white spaces are.
evidence_refs: Competing bookstores and cafes in the area
Other library governance models (3 case studies)
tradeoffs: May reveal uncomfortable truths about competitive disadvantage
Requires honest assessment of the library's actual vs. perceived value
rejected_alternatives: Ignoring the competitive landscape (risk of obsolescence)
Competing on features where we always lose (speed, convenience)

competitive_map.future_trajectory: Deeper algorithmic personalization and on-demand delivery become the default way people discover content.
Premiumized social spaces monetize aesthetics and curated selection for paying customers.
competitive_map.occupied_territory: Ambiance, social gathering, curated retail experience.

competitive_map.future_trajectory: Civic gathering spaces expand but remain disconnected from knowledge and learning resources.

white_spaces.description: Human-curated, community-governed knowledge with transparent, non-algorithmic collection decisions.
Interoperable governance across libraries that preserves local autonomy and community accountability.
